dark_rewards:
Unused Dark Space reward actors (dark_rewards1, dark_rewards2, dark_rewards3).

Prototype reward dispensers that hint at abilities and stat boosts.
Likely an earlier version of the Dark Space ability system before
it was integrated into sE6_gaia. Never referenced by any scene.
ec_proximity_door_toggle:
Proximity-based door open/close actor used across Edward Castle.

Monitors player distance and toggles door tile state.
Shared utility actor used by multiple castle rooms.
ec0E_lily:
Lily NPC in the aqueduct lockway.

Lily warns Will about demons and guides him through the
lockway puzzle. Multi-state dialog with movement sequences.
ec11_aqueduct_blocker:
Aqueduct doorway blocker actor.

Physical barrier that blocks passage until a puzzle condition
is met.
ec11_aqueduct_gate_sprite:
Aqueduct doorway gate sprite actor.

Visual gate sprite that animates open/closed states.
ec11_button_voice:
Mysterious voice at the aqueduct doorway buttons.

Multi-phase dialog: instructs Will to push switches simultaneously,
counts down, and announces when the door opens.
ec11_countdown:
Countdown dialog for the aqueduct doorway switch puzzle.

The strange voice counts 1-2-3 and Will must push the switch
at the right time. Includes timing-based success/failure.
ec11_flower:
Flower NPC in the aqueduct doorway.

Tells Will to play the Flute melody. Part of the melody-gated
progression system.
ec12_aqueduct_dark_space:
Dark Space portal in the aqueduct back area.

Spawns the dark space portal after flag check.
ec12_aqueduct_enemy:
Generic aqueduct enemy for the back area.

Standard dungeon enemy spawn with death handling.
ec13_lily:
Lily at the aqueduct exit.

Major story scene: Lily reveals herself after Will transforms,
explains she is from Itory Village, and the two begin their
journey together.
hint_npc:
Unused hint NPC actors (hint_npc1 through hint_npc8).

Prototype Gaia-like hint dispensers that display dialog based on
scene flags. Similar to the hint system in sE6_gaia but standalone.
Never referenced by any scene.
it1A_moon_tribe:
Moon Tribe encounter at their camp.

Major story scene: the Moon Tribe introduces themselves as
Shadows created by the comet's light. Exposition about the
comet, the transformation, and Shadow's origin. Complex
multi-phase dialog with cutscene elements.
unused_debug_input_test:
Unused debug actor for cycling through enemy spriteset frames.

Advances frame index $28 on each A-button press (0..$32), displaying
one sprite from spriteset_enemies per frame. Debug sprite viewer.
unused_debug_mode:
Unused debug initialization actor.

Sets player stats (HP=19, STR=32, DEF=33), character form to Shadow,
unlocks all abilities ($FF), sets MEMSEL fast ROM, flags the player
as dead ($0200), then enters the same sprite viewer loop as
unused_debug_input_test.
unused_kara_dialog:
Unused Kara dialog actor with looping music test.

Spawns a dialog child, alternates between music tracks #02 and #04
with a dialog prompt between each. Contains a single Kara dialog
line. Possibly a cutscene test or early Kara interaction prototype.
unused_mode7_boss:
Unused complete Mode 7 boss fight (~1,900 lines).

Full boss implementation with Mode 7 tilemap manipulation, orbital
attack patterns, HP tracking, phase transitions, projectile spawning,
and camera control. Uses ApplyOrbitalOffsetFromRef, hardware_math,
and enemy_stats_table. The largest unused code block in the ROM.
Possibly a cut boss or a prototype for the Babel Tower boss.
